roadmap.title: 9th Grade ' Foundations
roadmap.focus: Build strong science and math base, explore health and sports interests.

goals.title: Take Biology or Honors Biology
goals.description: Biology is foundational for anatomy, physiology, and medical pathways.

goals.title: Maintain strong math performance
goals.description: Aim for solid grades in Algebra I or Geometry to prepare for future physics and statistics.

goals.title: Join a sports team or fitness-related club
goals.description: Team sports, track, cross country, or fitness clubs help build movement awareness and discipline.

goals.title: Start volunteering (10''20 hours)
goals.description: Community centers, youth sports programs, or health-related volunteering is ideal.

goals.title: Learn about kinesiology and physical therapy careers
goals.description: Research what physical therapists and sports medicine professionals actually do daily.

roadmap.title: 10th Grade ' Skill Building
roadmap.focus: Increase academic rigor and begin career exposure.

goals.title: Take Chemistry or Honors Chemistry
goals.description: Chemistry supports later biology, physiology, and biomechanics understanding.

goals.title: Advance in math (Geometry or Algebra II)
goals.description: Strong math supports physics and biomechanics later in college.

goals.title: Volunteer or assist with sports teams or rehab programs
goals.description: Look for roles helping with training sessions, camps, or adaptive sports.

goals.title: Attend sports medicine or health career events
goals.description: Career days, hospital open houses, or athletic training demos are valuable.

goals.title: Start list of potential colleges and programs
goals.description: Begin identifying schools with kinesiology or pre-PT tracks.

roadmap.title: 11th Grade ' College Preparation
roadmap.focus: Academic excellence, testing, and serious career exploration.

goals.title: Take Physics or AP Biology
goals.description: Physics supports biomechanics; AP Bio strengthens medical foundations.

goals.title: Take PSAT / SAT / ACT
goals.description: Begin standardized testing and plan retakes if needed.

goals.title: Shadow a Physical Therapist or Sports Medicine professional
goals.description: Observation hours are critical for confirming interest and future applications.

goals.title: Volunteer in clinic, hospital, or athletic programs
goals.description: Build real healthcare exposure and references.

goals.title: Finalize college short list
goals.description: Compare program quality, prerequisites, and acceptance rates.

goals.title: Apply to kinesiology / exercise science programs
goals.description: Submit applications to multiple schools with strong health science tracks.

goals.title: Apply for scholarships and financial aid
goals.description: Complete FAFSA (US) or provincial aid forms (Canada) and private scholarships.

goals.title: Continue shadowing or volunteering
goals.description: Maintain exposure and strengthen recommendations.

goals.title: Maintain personal fitness and injury prevention habits
goals.description: Understanding your own movement health is part of being a future clinician.

goals.title: Confirm long-term path toward DPT or medical school
goals.description: Meet with advisors to plan undergraduate prerequisites for graduate programs.
